modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform a bounded read-only policy query with pinned selector/schema, field-level comparison and redacted evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds standard command, complete parsing and acceptance boundary to an undefined source.

project_override_considerations: A vendor read-only account API is equivalent only if it returns the same payload authorization fields for the same user/channel with equal freshness; it does not validate raw 0x4D tooling.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read objective and standard operation are identifiable. Selectors, schema and expected policy are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Restores bounded read-only automation while preventing account-policy enumeration, implicit payload activation and automatic repair through the setter.
independent_technical_reasoning: Payload-access bitmaps are security evidence, not permission to act. The query must be scoped to one approved user/channel and every returned field must be parsed against a pinned policy; any mismatch is reported for human review rather than converted into an automated authorization change.
